plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 61.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. The five Major Elective slots (3.0 units each) defer to the official major advising sheet linked on the program page (the official requirement per the sheet: choose 18 units of coursework from two or more disciplines); no course list is printed on the map itself, so these slots are modeled with empty option lists and a pointer to the sheet/counselor rather than a reconstructed list. The 1st-semester American Institutions slot is marked M (major course that also meets a general education requirement) on the official map and is modeled accordingly. None of the courses on this map carry an official course prerequisite in their published descriptions (all listed as Advisories); prereq arrays are intentionally empty — see the official catalog's course descriptions. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.

courses.title: Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences
courses.choice_note: Select one per the official map's RHC GE 2 slot: PSY 190 / STAT C1000 / STAT C1000H (encoded at the published 4.0 slot value). The map notes PSY 190 is the preferred math/quantitative reasoning course for Behavioral and Social Science majors; the notes also allow DSCI 101, FIN 101, MATH 140, MATH 150, MATH 160, MATH 170, MATH 175, MATH 180, MATH 190/H, PHIL 112/H, PHIL 115. PSY 190 - Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences; STAT C1000 - Introduction to Statistics; STAT C1000H - Introduction to Statistics Honors.
